name: Benefits and Programs API (Historical)
description:
This dataset is a historical snapshot of government benefit and social service programs, with 5,000 sampled rows and 34 columns. Each row describes a single program and includes identifying details such as a unique ID, program code, name, acronym, and plain-language name, along with classification fields like program category, page type, and the government agency responsible for it.

The data also covers who each program serves, including population served and age group, and provides descriptive content such as a program description, a brief excerpt, and a "heads up" note. A large portion of the columns focuses on access and application: plain-language eligibility, summaries of how to apply or enroll online, by mail, in person, or by phone, call-to-action text, links to online applications and PDF forms, office location links, and required documents. Additional fields explain how to get help in person, online, by email, by calling 311, or by calling other numbers. A language column and a date column
